metadata.desc: Dota 2 match tracking, image reports, rank broadcasts, daily/weekly reports and lookup commands (ported from koishi-plugin-dota2tracker).

common.onebotUnavailable: Some channels belong to a disabled platform and will not receive messages.

errors.internal_error: Internal server error; check the AstrBot log.
errors.channel_not_found: Channel not found; it may have been removed.
errors.player_not_found: Binding not found; it may have been removed.
errors.invalid_nickname: Nickname must be 1–20 characters without line breaks.
errors.import_too_large: The file exceeds the 2 MB limit.
errors.import_invalid_json: The file is not valid JSON.
errors.import_invalid_format: Unrecognised format: expected a file exported by this plugin.

common.noPlatform: No messaging platform adapter is running; reports cannot be delivered.
common.noOnebot: No OneBot (aiocqhttp) adapter detected: tip recall, member filtering and group cards/avatars are unavailable; everything else works.

overview.title: Overview
overview.noStratzToken: Stratz API token is not configured; queries and tracking are unavailable.

overview.noPending: No matches are waiting for parse

subscriptions.title: Subscriptions
subscriptions.empty: No channels or bindings yet. They appear here after using the subscribe/bind commands in a group.
subscriptions.noPlayers: No players bound in this channel
subscriptions.confirmUnsubscribe: Unsubscribe "{name}"? The channel stops receiving reports; bindings are kept.
subscriptions.orphansHint: These players belong to channels without a record (e.g. never subscribed) and are not tracked.
subscriptions.transferHint: Exports contain channels, bindings and ranks only, never tokens. Import accepts files exported by this plugin (backup/restore or moving to another AstrBot instance); existing bindings are never overwritten.
subscriptions.previewResult: Preview: {channelsAdded} channels to add, {channelsSkipped} skipped; {playersAdded} bindings to add, {playersSkipped} skipped.
subscriptions.importDone: Import finished: {channelsAdded} channels added, {channelsSkipped} skipped; {playersAdded} bindings added, {playersSkipped} skipped.
subscriptions.confirmImport: This adds {channels} channel subscriptions and {players} bindings. Import now?

templates.title: Templates
templates.fixtureHint: Previews are rendered from bundled fixtures without calling external APIs.
templates.noPreview: Choose a template and click "Render preview"
templates.systemFonts: Images use the default system fonts of the machine running the t2i service; the plugin neither bundles nor embeds fonts.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.confirmCheck: This sends a real request to {target} (uses API quota and is audited). Continue?
diagnostics.confirmClear: Clear every entry in cache namespace "{namespace}"?
diagnostics.confirmPurge: Purge all expired cache entries and sent-match markers?

stratz_api_token.hint: API token from https://stratz.com/api. Without it nothing can be queried and background tracking stays off.

data_parsing_timeout_minutes.hint: When a match is still unparsed after this time the report is published anyway. Range 0–1440.

proxy_address.hint: e.g. http://127.0.0.1:7890 or socks5://host:port. Leave empty for no proxy.

suppress_api_network_errors.description: Log network errors at debug level
suppress_api_network_errors.hint: Timeouts and connection failures from Stratz/OpenDota are logged as debug (403 excluded).

enable_opendota_fallback.hint: Use OpenDota for match tracking and queries when Stratz has no usable result.

opendota_api_key.hint: Paid OpenDota subscription key. Leave empty on the free tier.

opendota_ip_stack.hint: Force IPv4 if OpenDota requests keep failing (ignored when a proxy is set).

default_locale.hint: Runtime language for channels without their own setting.

use_hero_nicknames.hint: When off, only official hero names are used.

url_in_message_type.hint: match: Stratz match link; player: Stratz player link; hero: Dota wiki link.

max_send_item_count.hint: Above this count the next option decides whether to send the item list. Range 1–10.

show_item_list_at_too_much_items.description: Send item list when too many items
show_item_list_at_too_much_items.hint: Send an image of the matching items when the result exceeds the maximum.

custom_item_alias.hint: Add aliases missing from the built-in list, e.g. keyword: Blink Dagger, alias: blink.

auto_recall_tips.hint: Recall tips such as "Searching for the match…" after a command finishes (OneBot; ignored on failure).

rank_broad_fun.hint: Broadcast rank changes as an image.

daily_report_hours.hint: 0–23 in the AstrBot server time zone.

daily_report_show_combi.hint: Not used by the current daily report; kept for compatibility.

weekly_report_day_hours.hint: Two numbers: weekday (1–7, 7 = Sunday) and hour (0–23). Default Monday 10:00.

player_rank_estimate.hint: Estimate a rank for unranked players in the player template (shown in grey).

patch_notes_retrieval_depth.hint: Number of major versions of change history shown in hero/item templates, 1–5.

render_scale.hint: Device scale level of rendered images.
